old. A bare duration that appears in both versions proves nothing, so a phrase is quoted with
enough surrounding markup to be unique, and the old table rows are the negatives.

longer matches, BEFORE any live read, and refuses a set with no hash at all: there is no
fallback to default mode, because a stale positive assertion reports PASS on wording nobody
checked. After a wording edit, rewrite the sentences and paste the new coreSha256 from the
